paper.title: Multimedia Objective Practice Sample / 多媒体客观题全题型体验卷
paper.description: Comprehensive QA sample paper covering all 5 Objective Question Types with Image, Audio, and dual Image + Audio attachments. / 覆盖全部 5 种客观题型与图片、音频、图音双附的多媒体验收样例试卷。

questions.prompt: Based on the geometric angle diagram below, what is the value of the highlighted acute angle θ? / 观察下方几何角度图，图中突出显示的锐角 θ 的测量值是多少？

image.name: geometry-angles.svg
image.alt: Geometric angle diagram with theta and 90 degree reference line

questions.prompt: Listen to the audio sequence above. Which statements accurately describe the pitch pattern heard? / 仔细聆听上方音频片段。以下关于所听到的音调高低特征描述哪些是正确的？

options.text: The pitch sequence follows a Low → High → Low melodic contour. / 音调高低起伏遵循“低 → 高 → 低”的变化轮廓。
The first and third tone bursts share the same lower fundamental frequency. / 第 1 声与第 3 声脉冲具有相同的较低基频。
The pitch sequence is strictly ascending from start to end. / 音高从头到尾呈单调持续上升。
The sequence consists of continuous white noise without distinct tonal frequencies. / 该音频由无固定音高的连续白噪声构成。

questions.prompt: Listen to the chime audio while examining the singly linked list diagram. What is the integer value stored in the middle node (labeled 'Node')? / 聆听提示音并观察单向链表结构图。中间节点（标识为 'Node'）所存储的整数值是多少？

image.name: data-structure.svg
image.alt: Singly linked list diagram showing Head node with value 12, middle node with value 45, and tail node pointing to NULL

questions.prompt: In the provided linked list structure diagram, the tail node points to NULL, indicating the termination of the list. / 在提供的链表结构图中，尾节点指向 NULL，表示链表在此终止。

image.name: data-structure.svg
image.alt: Singly linked list diagram ending with Tail: NULL

questions.prompt: Listen to the 880 Hz high-pitch beep tone above and match each audio and diagram term with its correct technical definition. / 聆听上方 880 Hz 高频脉冲音，将各项多媒体与结构术语与右侧对应的技术定义进行匹配连接。
